info.title: mddb API Reference
info.description: RESTful JSON API for mddb at `/api/v1/`.

AcceptInvitationRequest.description:
AcceptInvitationRequest claims a grant for the authenticated account.
Recipient-bound invitations additionally require a matching verified address.
Invitation tokens never authenticate a user or issue a session.

ErrorCode.description:
ErrorCode defines specific error types for the API.

- `VALIDATION_FAILED`: ErrorCodeValidationFailed is returned when input data fails validation.
- `MISSING_FIELD`: ErrorCodeMissingField is returned when a required field is missing.
- `INVALID_FORMAT`: ErrorCodeInvalidFormat is returned when a field has an invalid format.
- `NOT_FOUND`: ErrorCodeNotFound is returned when a resource is not found.
- `NODE_NOT_FOUND`: ErrorCodeNodeNotFound is returned when a node is not found.
- `TABLE_NOT_FOUND`: ErrorCodeTableNotFound is returned when a table is not found.
- `FILE_NOT_FOUND`: ErrorCodeFileNotFound is returned when a file is not found.
- `STORAGE_ERROR`: ErrorCodeStorageError is returned when a storage operation fails.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR`: ErrorCodeInternal is returned when an unexpected server error occurs.
- `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`: ErrorCodeNotImplemented is returned when a feature is not implemented.
- `CONFLICT`: ErrorCodeConflict is returned when there is a resource conflict.
- `UNAUTHORIZED`: ErrorCodeUnauthorized is returned when authentication is missing or invalid.
- `FORBIDDEN`: ErrorCodeForbidden is returned when a user has insufficient permissions.
- `INVALID_PROVIDER`: ErrorCodeInvalidProvider is returned when an OAuth provider is unknown.
- `OAUTH_ERROR`: ErrorCodeOAuthError is returned when an OAuth operation fails.
- `EXPIRED`: ErrorCodeExpired is returned when a resource has expired.
- `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: ErrorCodeRateLimitExceeded is returned when rate limit is exceeded.
- `CANNOT_UNLINK_ONLY_AUTH`: ErrorCodeCannotUnlinkOnlyAuth is returned when trying to unlink the only authentication method.
- `PROVIDER_ALREADY_LINKED`: ErrorCodeProviderAlreadyLinked is returned when trying to link an already linked provider.
- `PROVIDER_NOT_LINKED`: ErrorCodeProviderNotLinked is returned when trying to unlink a provider that is not linked.
- `EMAIL_IN_USE`: ErrorCodeEmailInUse is returned when an email is already in use by another account.
- `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`: ErrorCodeEmailNotVerified is returned when independent proof of email ownership is missing for an invitation or account link.
- `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`: ErrorCodeQuotaExceeded is returned when a server-wide quota is exceeded.
- `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: ErrorCodePayloadTooLarge is returned when the request body exceeds the size limit.

ErrorDetails.description: ErrorDetails defines the structured error information in a response.

ErrorResponse.description: ErrorResponse is the standard API error response.

EventAspect.description: EventAspect identifies a changed projection independently of canonical CAS.

EventType.description:
EventType identifies the kind of workspace event sent via SSE.

- `node_created`: EventNodeCreated is sent when a new node (page or table) is created.
- `node_updated`: EventNodeUpdated is sent when a node's content or title changes.
- `node_deleted`: EventNodeDeleted is sent when a node is removed.
- `node_moved`: EventNodeMoved is sent when a node is moved to a new parent.
- `records_changed`: EventRecordsChanged is sent when a table record is created, updated, or deleted.
- `table_updated`: EventTableUpdated is sent when a table schema or view changes.
- `resync`: EventResync requires an authorized refresh after an event delivery gap.

Filter.description: Filter defines a condition for filtering records.

FilterOp.description:
FilterOp defines the comparison operator for a filter.

- `equals`: FilterOpEquals matches if value equals the filter value.
- `not_equals`: FilterOpNotEquals matches if value does not equal the filter value.
- `contains`: FilterOpContains matches if value contains the filter value (text).
- `not_contains`: FilterOpNotContains matches if value does not contain the filter value.
- `starts_with`: FilterOpStartsWith matches if value starts with the filter value.
- `ends_with`: FilterOpEndsWith matches if value ends with the filter value.
- `gt`: FilterOpGreaterThan matches if value is greater than the filter value.
- `lt`: FilterOpLessThan matches if value is less than the filter value.
- `gte`: FilterOpGreaterEqual matches if value is greater than or equal to the filter value.
- `lte`: FilterOpLessEqual matches if value is less than or equal to the filter value.
- `is_empty`: FilterOpIsEmpty matches if value is empty/null.
- `is_not_empty`: FilterOpIsNotEmpty matches if value is not empty/null.

OAuthIdentity.description: OAuthIdentity represents a link between a local user and an OAuth2 provider.

OAuthProvider.description:
OAuthProvider represents a supported OAuth2 provider.

- `google`: OAuthProviderGoogle represents Google OAuth.
- `microsoft`: OAuthProviderMicrosoft represents Microsoft OAuth.
- `github`: OAuthProviderGitHub represents GitHub OAuth.

OkResponse.description: OkResponse is a simple success response.

OrgInvitationInfoRequest.description: OrgInvitationInfoRequest previews a token-selected organization grant without claiming it.

OrgInvitationInfoResponse.description: OrgInvitationInfoResponse describes a token-selected organization grant.

OrganizationQuotas.description: OrganizationQuotas defines limits for an organization.

OrganizationResponse.description: OrganizationResponse is the API representation of an organization.

server_resource_limits.description:
ServerResourceLimits shows the server-imposed upper bound for each resource quota.
The organization's resource quotas cannot exceed these server-level limits.

OrganizationRole.description:
OrganizationRole defines the role of a user within an organization.

- `org:owner`: OrgRoleOwner has full control including billing.
- `org:admin`: OrgRoleAdmin can manage workspaces and members.
- `org:member`: OrgRoleMember can only access granted workspaces.

Property.description: Property represents a table column with its configuration.

options.description:
Options contains the allowed values for select and multi_select properties.
Each option has an ID (used in storage), name (display), and optional color.

PropertyType.description:
PropertyType represents the type of a table property.

- `text`: PropertyTypeText stores plain text values.
- `number`: PropertyTypeNumber stores numeric values (integer or float).
- `checkbox`: PropertyTypeCheckbox stores boolean values.
- `date`: PropertyTypeDate stores ISO8601 date strings.
- `select`: PropertyTypeSelect stores a single selection from predefined options.
- `multi_select`: PropertyTypeMultiSelect stores multiple selections from predefined options.
- `user`: PropertyTypeUser stores a reference to a workspace member by user ID.
- `url`: PropertyTypeURL stores URLs with validation.
- `email`: PropertyTypeEmail stores email addresses with validation.
- `phone`: PropertyTypePhone stores phone numbers with validation.

ResolvedUser.description:
ResolvedUser represents a resolved user reference from a user-type column value.
IsGhost is true when the user ID is valid but the user is no longer a member.

ResourceQuotas.description:
ResourceQuotas defines per-workspace content limits shared by server, org, and workspace layers.
At org and workspace layers: -1 means "inherit from parent", 0 means "disabled", positive means a limit.
At server layer all fields must be strictly positive.

SessionResponse.description: SessionResponse is the API representation of a session.

SortDir defines the sort direction.

- `asc`: SortAsc sorts in ascending order (A-Z, 0-9, oldest-newest).
- `desc`: SortDesc sorts in descending order (Z-A, 9-0, newest-oldest).

VAPIDKeyResponse.description: VAPIDKeyResponse returns the server's VAPID public key.

View.description: View represents a saved table view configuration.

ViewColumn.description: ViewColumn defines the visibility and width of a property column.

ViewType.description:
ViewType defines the layout type for a view.

- `table`: ViewTypeTable displays records in a spreadsheet-like table.
- `board`: ViewTypeBoard displays records in a kanban board grouped by a property.
- `gallery`: ViewTypeGallery displays records as cards in a grid.
- `list`: ViewTypeList displays records in a simple list.
- `calendar`: ViewTypeCalendar displays records on a calendar by date property.

WSInvitationInfoRequest.description: WSInvitationInfoRequest previews a token-selected workspace grant without claiming it.

WSInvitationInfoResponse.description: WSInvitationInfoResponse describes a token-selected workspace grant.

WSInvitationResponse.description: WSInvitationResponse is the API representation of a workspace invitation with an administrator-copyable link.

WSMembershipResponse.description: WSMembershipResponse is the API representation of a workspace membership.

WorkspaceEvent.description: WorkspaceEvent is the payload sent to SSE clients for real-time workspace updates.

change_id.description:
ChangeID is an opaque process-epoch invalidation watermark, not a read
snapshot revision. Reconnection or a delivery gap requires resynchronization.

request_id.description: RequestID correlates a change with an individual HTTP write, not authorization.

revision.description: Revision identifies canonical title/body CAS, not full resource freshness.

summary_parents.description:
SummaryParents identifies at most two listings whose returned child summaries
may change HasChildren after a committed hierarchy mutation.

WorkspaceMemberResponse.description:
WorkspaceMemberResponse is a compact user representation for workspace member listings.
Used by the user column type to populate the picker and display names.

WorkspaceMembershipSettings.description: WorkspaceMembershipSettings represents user preferences within a specific workspace.

WorkspaceResponse.description: WorkspaceResponse is the API representation of a workspace.

parent_resource_limits.description:
ParentResourceLimits shows the effective upper bound imposed by the server and organization.
The workspace's resource quotas cannot exceed these combined limits.
Zero means unlimited at the parent level.

WorkspaceRole.description:
WorkspaceRole defines the permissions for a user within a workspace.

- `ws:admin`: WSRoleAdmin has full workspace control.
- `ws:editor`: WSRoleEditor can create and modify content.
- `ws:viewer`: WSRoleViewer can only read content.
